title: Global classical solutions of the three-dimensional relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system
summary: We prove global existence and uniqueness for arbitrary smooth admissible initial data in the three-dimensional, one-species relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system. The particle density is initially compactly supported, and the electromagnetic fields have finite energy and bounded derivatives of all orders. The solution remains smooth on every finite time interval. This resolves the large-data global classical regularity problem for this model, without size or symmetry restrictions on the data.

review.reason: Establishes global classical well-posedness for the relativistic Vlasov–Maxwell system with large data.
